title: Turn scores into probabilities
brief: Build a sigmoid that stays finite at a score of 800, its inverse the logit, and a function that scores a whole data matrix.
hints: Build a mask pos = z >= 0. On the positive part use 1 / (1 + np.exp(-z)). On the rest use np.exp(z) / (1 + np.exp(z)). Neither exponent is ever positive.
Allocate the output with np.empty_like(z) after converting z to a float array, and fill it through the mask. np.where evaluates both branches on every entry, so it overflows.
logit(p) is np.log(p / (1 - p)). It must undo sigmoid: logit(sigmoid(z)) returns z.
predict_proba is one line once sigmoid works: apply sigmoid to X @ w. The result has shape (n,).
